activity_summary: You came home with the back complaining from the fourth hour. The three gingerbread men went to Alse. Mistress Ansell said fairings rot the teeth.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Gave Alse the three gingerbread men, and went up.

entities.name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell
entities.context: Said fairings rot the teeth, and saw the stair-post.

entities.name: Alse Pinder
entities.context: Took them, and kept the gilt one for the shelf.

entities.name: three gingerbread men
entities.context: Mentioned in Fairings rot the teeth

facets.activity: Gave the three gingerbread men to Alse

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: Here, Alse. Three of them, out of Smithfield, and the middle one has gilt on him
